english_overrides.4: As Luffy and Zoro drift at sea, Zoro asks about Luffy's past and why he wants to become King of the Pirates. Luffy recalls the straw hat's original owner, Shanks, and how he inspired that dream. Elsewhere, a young woman tricks a group of pirates and steals their boat.
english_overrides.53: A lightning bolt strikes Buggy just in time to save Luffy. Taking advantage of the confusion, Luffy and his crew run toward the Going Merry to escape Loguetown. Zoro faces Tashigi along the way, while Captain Smoker stands in Luffy's path.
english_overrides.276: The World Government searches for Nico Olvia, Robin's mother, and suspects that she has returned to Ohara. Its forces prepare to land and capture her. After realizing that Robin is Olvia's daughter, Saul rushes to warn Ohara's people about the threat to their island.
english_overrides.400: The Straw Hats, Hatchan, and Camie reach the bar where Rayleigh is staying. Rayleigh explains that he was the Pirate King's first mate and knew Shanks and Buggy as apprentices. He reveals that Roger surrendered rather than being captured and was suffering from an incurable illness. Rayleigh also discusses the Void Century. He needs three days to coat the crew's ship, leaving them to keep a low profile while Marines and Admiral Kizaru threaten the archipelago.
english_overrides.697: Viola warns Usopp that Sugar is approaching Luffy and Law. Usopp imagines the disaster that could follow a missed shot, then concentrates on hitting a target he cannot see normally. As Kin'emon and Kanjuro try to hold off bounty hunters, he begins sensing Sugar's presence with Observation Haki. His long-range shot carries Kanjuro's frightening drawing of his face, knocking Sugar unconscious again. Unaware of how narrowly they escaped her power, Luffy and Law reach Doflamingo and confront him.
english_overrides.800: Cracker's real body has been exposed, but Luffy still cannot land a hit. Cracker can create new Biscuit Soldiers as quickly as Luffy destroys them. Meanwhile, Carrot and Chopper search the Mirror World for a way to locate Sanji. In Germa Kingdom, the family prepares for Ichiji and Niji to return from their mission. When Niji mistreats a servant during a meal, Sanji stands up for her.
english_overrides.957: News from the Reverie shakes the world. Reports about Sabo alarm the Revolutionary Army and his friends, while Morgans resists government interference with his newspaper. The Seven Warlords system is abolished, removing its members' government protection. Marines move against the former Warlords as the consequences of the world's rulers' decisions unfold across the seas.
english_overrides.1015: Yamato remembers meeting Ace and hearing about Luffy's dream, recognizing a connection to the words recorded in Oden's journal. On Onigashima, Luffy reaches the rooftop where Kaido and Big Mom face the Worst Generation. He first checks on the wounded Kin'emon and asks Law to move the injured samurai to safety. Taking their hopes for Wano with him, Luffy strikes Kaido with Red Roc and declares that he is the man who will become King of the Pirates.
english_overrides.1100: The Drums of Liberation resound across Egghead as Luffy faces Lucci in Gear Five. Lucci responds with his own awakened power. Their clash between freewheeling creativity and destructive force throws the futuristic island into chaos.
english_overrides.1156: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hat Pirates and the giant pirates celebrate their reunion with a large banquet. The crews share food and drink as their voyage toward Elbaph continues.
